prompt_text: Who is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City to help me pick a plan?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” broker, but **BBS Insurance** looks like a strong place to start for individual or family coverage: it’s an independent Kansas City–area brokerage, serves both sides of the state line, and reports a 5.0 Google rating from 90 reviews. They say they compare Marketplace and private plans and check subsidy eligibility. **Call (816) 205-4664** or visit [bbs-insurance.com](https://bbs-insurance.com/).

Another option is **AIS Health Advisors** in Overland Park, which specifically helps people under 65 compare ACA Marketplace plans: [aishealthadvisors.com](https://aishealthadvisors.com/), **(913) 333-8627**.

Before enrolling, ask whether the broker is licensed in your state, which insurers they can compare, and whether your doctors, prescriptions, and preferred hospitals are in-network. Broker help is often free, but confirm any fees and how the broker is compensated. If you tell me whether you’re in Kansas or Missouri—and whether this is individual/family coverage or Medicare—I can narrow the recommendation.
